answer: An agent economy can weight votes by collateral locked for 30 days, with each dollar counted only once across all identities. Calling its copies onyx, juniper, and opal gives an attacker no extra voting power: splitting $1,000 among them still buys only $1,000 of weight. To gain more influence, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital, paying financing costs and losing access to that money during the lock.
